headers.Subject:
[PATCH] soundwire: qcom: wait for fifo space to be available before
 read/write
headers.Cc:
robh@kernel.org, alsa-devel@alsa-project.org, devicetree@vger.kernel.org,
 pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com, linux-kernel@vger.kernel.org,

headers.List-Id:

 http://www.alsa-project.org" <alsa-devel.alsa-project.org>

content:
If we write registers very fast we can endup in a situation where some
of the writes will be dropped without any notice.

So wait for the fifo space to be available before reading/writing the
soundwire registers.

Signed-off-by: Srinivas Kandagatla <srinivas.kandagatla@linaro.org>
